caption: Physical Site
description: Adds physical site context through the physical_site object: the site identity (physical_site.uid, physical_site.name) and the location within the site (building, floor, site_zone). The profile is attached where the event itself takes place at a site the producer can name: the Identity & Access Management classes (an access decision at a reader, or the administration of access rights to a site's doors, correlated with logical access at the same site) and the Findings classes (findings raised about, or aggregated by, a site). It is also applied to the location object, so a device, endpoint, or person in any class carries physical site context through its location; when the profile is applied, physical_site alone satisfies that object's at-least-one constraint, so an indoor reader or device need not carry geographic attributes. Further categories can be added as producers appear.
name: physical_site
